text_block_list.text:
Hearing singing from the rooftop, I went to check on it...
and found TM Opera O there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Aah~~♪ This is our era~~♪
We shall let no one stand in our wa~~y♪"

Apparently, she was rehearsing for a play.
Fascinated, I stopped in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my, is that you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I had just finished my practice.
All that remains now is to welcome tomorrow's performance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oops... a phone call. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph... I see.
Then it cannot be helped. ...Farewell for now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then... I must devise a solution.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing to fret over.
Due to a stage equipment malfunction, the booked stage
has become unavailable. That is all!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
First, let us search for a new stage!
For there are still countless theaters in this world!
TM Opera O made inquiries to theaters and halls all around, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Umu, totally wiped out!
Every single place was fully booked, it seems!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, if there is no stage, one simply has to create it oneself!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I would love to hear your opinion as well.
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I intend to make this my stage!
What do you think? A truly magnificent view, is it not!
choice_data_list: The wind is so strong, I doubt your voice will carry...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Is there not a possibility that it is an auspicious wind
sent to carry my beautiful voice?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Aah~~♪ This is our era~~♪
We shall let no one stand in our wa~~y♪"
choice_data_list: I can't hear you at all...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Well played, wind!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! We shall change the setting to a wind-swept city!
I shall incorporate a scene where my cape flutters
magnificently in the gale!
choice_data_list: What about the issue with your voice?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If my voice cannot echo, then I need only draw closer to the audience!
Let us add more scenes where I wander through the seats!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall revise the script into direct dialogue as well!
Ha, I am the sole performer! In short, as long as my rehearsals finish in time, it is of no consequence!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is it not obvious?
Because there is an audience waiting for me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can see it before my very eyes...!
The crowd surging with fervor at my mise-en-scène, melting before my cadenza!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If they desire it, then joy I shall bestow!
A world overflowing with bliss, I shall grant them!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Await me! Tomorrow's stage shall be crafted into the greatest masterpiece of my life!
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the front row is my highest recommendation!
By all means, come bear witness to my glorious triumph!
――The next day. TM Opera O finished the script in the nick of time and took the stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Never succumb to the murderous blade!
Indeed, the hour to rise has come~~♪
Come, let us walk the road to glory together~~~♪"
Watching TM Opera O's breathtaking, passionate performance up close, I was unable to contain my excitement!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall entrust the publicity to you.
Please spread the word far and wide that the venue has changed!

――The next day. The audience was sparse.
Even though the venue change had been properly announced...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, gathered souls!
I shall present to you the greatest story ever told!
Please, enjoy yourselves to your hearts' content!

The size of the crowd did not matter to her in the slightest.
Seeing her act with total sincerity, speaking to each and every person, truly touched my heart...!
